title: Lodha Massimo
location: Pan Card Club Road, Baner Hills, Pune
tagline: Under Construction | Highest Point in Baner | Pan Card Club Road
overview: Lodha Massimo is a premium 3 & 4 BHK residential development by the Lodha Group, set at the highest point in Baner along Pan Card Club Road at the foothills of Baner Hill. The project is built around roughly 1,00,000 sq ft of central landscaped open space and offers a wide sports and leisure programme — a 25m lap pool, Sky Sports Club, multi-use courts, a padel court and 5-a-side football turf — alongside everyday conveniences like a café-cum-library and a dedicated pets' area. It sits close to Baner and Balewadi's IT parks (5–20 minutes), with malls, hospitals and schools nearby.
